by: claude: tax back-fill 2015 onward, the four taxes the ten-year report reads (Portugal)
note: Portugal tax years 2015 to 2025 (calendar), from PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries copies dated inside each year (review date in each note); 2016 from the EY Worldwide Personal Tax and Immigration Guide 2016-17 (no PwC copy dated in 2016); the 2018 wealth rows from Deloitte "Portugal Highlights 2018". Rows from 2026 were already on file.

rates.note: "As a general rule, capital gains will be subject to tax at a flat rate of 28%"; only 50% of gains on shares of unlisted micro and small companies is taxed; residents may opt to aggregate at progressive rates (PwC, last reviewed 1 Jul 2015).
